name: Moingfhionn
text: Moingfhionn and Moingionn are Modern Irish spellings of Mongfhind, a name carried by several women of early Irish story. The best known of them, Mongfhind (2), is the wife of Eochaid Mugmedón.

attributes.attribute: Modern Irish rendering of a multi-bearer female name

okr.objective: Documents Moingfhionn as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Moingfhionn and Moingionn are Modern Irish spellings of Mongfhind.
Several early-Irish women carry the name.
The best known, Mongfhind (2), is Eochaid Mugmedón's wife.
